scripts.text:
- Wait a moment! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please come back later -
- after you put some items into kafra storage. -
scripts.translation:
- 请稍等！ -
- 您目前携带的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 请将部分物品存入卡普拉仓库后 -
- 再回来。 -

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
Ummmm...
What brings you here...?
scripts.translation:
[老药剂师]
嗯……
您来这里是……？

scripts.text: Make Potion
scripts.translation: 制作药水

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Mixing Information
scripts.translation: 调配资讯

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
Why are you carrying these so many!
Don't be greedy, carry only as much you need!
scripts.translation:
[老药剂师]
您怎么带了这么多东西！
别贪心，只带您需要的数量！

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
You are too heavy to receive potions from me...
Go store some items in your storage first!
scripts.translation:
[老药剂师]
您携带的物品太重了，无法从我这里领取药水……
请先去仓库存放一些物品！

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
You have all the stuff ready, right? Which one would you like?
scripts.translation:
[老药剂师]
材料都准备好了吗？您想要哪一种？

scripts.text: Red Potion.
scripts.translation: 红色药水

scripts.text: Orange Potion.
scripts.translation: 赤色药水

scripts.text: Yellow Potion.
scripts.translation: 黄色药水

scripts.text: White Potion.
scripts.translation: 白色药水

scripts.text: Blue Potion.
scripts.translation: 蓝色药水

scripts.text: Green Potion.
scripts.translation: 绿色药水

scripts.text: Actually, I don't want anything.
scripts.translation: 其实我什么都不想要。

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
You rascal! What did you expect?! Coming here with nothing. Tsk!
Get lost!
scripts.translation:
[老药剂师]
你这小鬼！你指望什么？！两手空空来这里。哼！
快滚！

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
How many?
scripts.translation:
[老药剂师]
要多少？

scripts.text: Make as many as I can.
scripts.translation: 尽可能多地制作。

scripts.text: I want to choose an amount.
scripts.translation: 我想选择数量。

scripts.text: Actually, I don't want anything.
scripts.translation: 其实我什么都不想要。

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
You rascal! You don't even have all the materials and you want me to make you potions?!
scripts.translation:
[老药剂师]
你这小鬼！材料都不齐，还想让我给你做药水？！

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
Then pick a number below 100. If you don't want any, just enter '0'. With the materials you have, you can make about {0} potions.
scripts.translation:
[老药剂师]
请输入100以下的数字。如果不想制作，请输入“0”。以您现有的材料，大约可以制作{0}瓶药水。

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
Make up your mind, will you?!
scripts.translation:
[老药剂师]
你到底想怎样？！

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
Are you deaf? I said less than 100!
scripts.translation:
[老药剂师]
你聋了吗？我说是100以下！

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
You rascal! You don't even have all the materials and you want me to make you potions?!
scripts.translation:
[老药剂师]
你这小鬼！材料都不齐，还想让我给你做药水？！

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
What?!
Grrr...
Bleh!
Get lost!
scripts.translation:
[老药剂师]
什么？！
哼...
呸！
滚开！

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
Here you go. It's all done so you can take it. But remember! Abusing medicine is not good.
scripts.translation:
[老药剂师]
给你。都做好了，你可以拿走了。但是记住！滥用药物是不好的。

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
What?!
Grrr...
Bleh!
Get lost!
scripts.translation:
[老药剂师]
什么？！
哼...
呸！
滚开！

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
With medicine, you can increase a person's ability to regenerate. But, they're only good up to a point. *Sigh* I'm starting to think of the days when I was young. I must be getting old.
scripts.translation:
[老药剂师]
药物可以增强人的再生能力。但效果也是有限度的。*叹气* 我开始怀念年轻的时候了。我一定是老了。

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
Anyways, a potion is merely a potion. Nothing more and nothing less.
scripts.translation:
[老药剂师]
总之，药水只是药水而已。不多也不少。

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
Hrrrmm...
You young ones can be quite annoying. But, since you asked, I'll explain.
scripts.translation:
[老药剂师]
嗯...
你们年轻人真让人头疼。不过既然你问了，我就解释一下。

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
Herbs work well by themselves, but if you use my special techniques and skills to make potions out of them, the effect is much much greater.
scripts.translation:
[老药剂师]
药草单独使用效果不错，但如果用我特殊的技巧和技能将它们制成药水，效果会大得多。

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
If you ask eagerly and politely, I will make them for you. But, not for free... Don't worry though, I only charge a small fee, so it's not that expensive.
scripts.translation:
[老药剂师]
如果你诚恳礼貌地请求，我会为你制作。但不是免费的...不过别担心，我只收取少量费用，所以并不贵。

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
What a boring person. If you have something to say, why don't you say it?!
scripts.translation:
[老药剂师]
真是个无聊的人。有话就说，为什么不说出来？！
